description: The line plot illustrates the growth in vocabulary size over the number of iterations for three languages—Spanish, Korean, and Japanese—within the DIY-MKG system. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Iterations,” spans from 0 to 500 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis, labeled “Vocabulary Size,” ranges from 0 to 5000, also with linear scaling and tick marks every 1000 units. The Spanish vocabulary is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting near 0 and rising to approximately 3000 by iteration 500. The Korean vocabulary is shown with a solid orange line and circular markers, beginning near 0 and reaching about 2900 at iteration 500. The Japanese vocabulary is depicted by a solid green line with circular markers, starting near 0 and increasing to roughly 3100 by iteration 500. All three lines exhibit a roughly linear upward trend, with Japanese consistently slightly ahead of Spanish and Korean across the iterations. A faint gray diagonal line extends from (0,0) to (500,5000), likely serving as a reference for maximum possible growth. A light gray rectangular bar is positioned near the bottom center of the plot, around x=300, though its purpose is not labeled.
